formatDescription: The Observation RINEX (Receiver Independent Exchange Format) Format is a standard ASCII text file containing raw Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) measurement data such as pseudoranges, carrier phases, Doppler shifts, and signal-to-noise ratios collected by a receiver antenna from multiple satellite constellations
formatNote: RINEX: The Receiver Independent Exchange Format Version 2.10: https://files.igs.org/pub/data/format/rinex210.txt
provenanceCompoundName: Digital Research Alliance of Canada - FRDR / Alliance de recherche numérique du Canada – DFDR
